insights.summary: Q1 FY27 revenue rose 145% to ₹716 Cr on 61% higher volumes, with EBITDA of ₹71 Cr (10%) and PAT of ₹50 Cr; about 2-2.5 points of the margin came from inventory gains released after the change to weighted-average costing. Management kept FY27 guidance at 30-40% volume growth but trimmed value growth to 50-60% (while also citing ₹3,500 Cr), and guided a 7.5-8% EBITDA and ~4% PAT margin. The Marol plant started in June, Jaipur slipped to November-December, and a ₹100 Cr rights issue opened a year after the IPO.
